context: This criteria evaluates the proper use of query string building methods to construct parameterized API requests.

checklist.name: Query method usage
checklist.description: Uses the .query() method to add query parameters to requests

checklist.name: Object-based parameters
checklist.description: Passes query parameters as objects (key-value pairs) rather than manually constructing strings

checklist.name: Parameter accumulation
checklist.description: Correctly chains multiple .query() calls to accumulate parameters incrementally
